scope: Offline paired technical replay only. Every held-out and GNSS gate stays in force in the real runtime; no parking or route credit.

cases.winner_rule: Minimum held-out surface p95 after all seven LiDAR starts mutually converge within 8 cm / 0.015 rad; no truth or GNSS winner selection
cases.training_choice: Archived stationary startup only. Trim to nearest 60% of fitting-half correspondences and 4 cm Huber; 7 yaw guesses are a single capture.
cases.fixture: cold coarse hint; same stationary vehicle
